---
title: "Correlation analysis"
output: html_document

```{r, load-data}
set.seed(getOption("EpiATLAS_AS_SEED", 42L))

# Per-filter (PLAN §4.12e): 06 runs ONE transcript_filter per invocation.
# `load("processed_data/aggregating.rda")` is GONE — that workspace is no longer
# produced by the per-filter refactor. The two objects it supplied that aren't
# .Rprofile globals are read explicitly here:
#   metadata      <- sample metadata sheet (annotation join)
#   file_metadata <- file_table (uuid -> protocol)
# (to_analyze/histone_marks/cor_methods/minimum_events/variability_colors/
#  mark_hex_colors/plot_dir/sample_metadata_file all come from .Rprofile.)
this_transcript_filter <- Sys.getenv(
  "TRANSCRIPT_FILTER",
  getOption("EpiATLAS_AS_PRIMARY_FILTER", "biotype_filtered")
)
# single filter per run -> facet-level vector is just this one
transcript_filters <- this_transcript_filter
metadata <- fread(sample_metadata_file)
file_metadata <- fread("processed_data/file_table.csv.gz")
aggregated_dt <- fread(
  sprintf(
    "processed_data/aggregated_dt_filtered_%s.csv.gz",
    this_transcript_filter
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = TRUE
)
source("05zz-feature-preprocessing.R")
aggregated_dt[, `Event Type` := factor(`Event Type`, levels = to_analyze)]

# set some global_variables
meta_exclude_cols <- c(
  "ID",
  "PSI",
  "IHEC",
  "Event Type",
  "gene_id",
  "Variability",
  "annotation",
  "uuid",
  "transcript_filter",
  "seqnames",
  "ontology",
  "project",
  "protocol",
  # §4.12b: keep gene_expression_vst as the conditioning feature (below);
  # exclude the pooled-model getmm copy so it isn't double-counted.
  "gene_expression_getmm"
)
sdcols <- names(aggregated_dt)[!names(aggregated_dt) %in% meta_exclude_cols]
# Drop columns that must NOT enter the numeric PSI correlation:
#   *_source  -> §4.13l categorical strings ("observed"/"imputed") -> cor() NA/err
#   ^rbp_ / ^spliceosome_ -> new RBP/spliceosome feature families (05 §4.12f);
#     06's scope is epigenetic marks + intrinsic features, so keep it stable —
#     RBP/spliceosome correlation is a separate analysis, not folded in here.
sdcols <- sdcols[
  !grepl(
    "_source$", #|^rbp_|^spliceosome_",
    sdcols
  )
]
aggregation_columns <- c(
  "Event Type",
  "transcript_filter",
  "uuid",
  "Variability"
)
# Intrinsic (cis / non-epigenetic) covariates the partial correlation conditions
# on. Rationale (the correlation runs ACROSS EVENTS within a sample -> a cross-
# gene axis): condition on per-event properties that could spuriously drive a
# mark<->PSI correlation, WITHOUT over-conditioning on a PSI proxy.
#   - gene_expression_vst : host-gene expression. vst is length-normalised (run
#     on lengthScaledTPM in 02-2, NOT raw counts) AND variance-stabilised ->
#     well-behaved cross-gene covariate for the lm residualisation. (getmm would
#     need log1p and gains nothing here.) Used raw via lm().
#   - distances : transcript-relative TSS/TES kept; the near-collinear gene-
#     relative distance_gene_start/_end DROPPED (redundant, transcript-relative
#     is the splicing-relevant frame).
#   - widths : exon/intron length drives inclusion and mark footprint.
#   - splice-site STRENGTH : MaxEntScan (local 9/23-mer) AND Pangolin psite
#     (P(splice site), 10 kb context) — complementary cis predictors (r~0.3-0.5),
#     so conditioning on both = strict "chromatin beyond sequence". Pangolin
#     *usage* is deliberately EXCLUDED — it's a direct PSI proxy, conditioning on
#     it would erase the signal, not a confound. (Residualisation is robust to
#     collinearity among conditioners; RI's NA-for-that-type sites 5ssup/3ssdown
#     are dropped per-group in partial_cor.)
non_epigenetic_features <- c(
  "gene_expression_vst",
  "distance_TSS",
  "distance_TES",
  "width;upstream_other_region",
  "width;event_name",
  "width;downstream_other_region",
  "3ss",
  "3ssdown",
  "5ss",
  "5ssup",
  "pangolin_5ss_psite_mean",
  "pangolin_5ssup_psite_mean",
  "pangolin_3ss_psite_mean",
  "pangolin_3ssdown_psite_mean"
)
main_cor <- "spearman"
main_variability <- "All"
main_partial <- TRUE
main_protocol <- "All"
main_preprocessing <- "Preprocessed"
preprocessing_colors <- c(
  "Raw" = "grey55",
  "Preprocessed" = "#1b9e77"
)
```

```{r, generate-cor-dt}
corr_file_raw <- sprintf(
  "processed_data/correlation_intrinsic_%s.csv.gz",
  this_transcript_filter
)
corr_file_preproc <- sprintf(
  "processed_data/correlation_intrinsic_preproc_%s.csv.gz",
  this_transcript_filter
)

full_cor <- function(y, PSI, cor_method, this_minimum_events = minimum_events) {
  rmv <- is.na(y) | is.na(PSI)
  res <- NA_real_
  if ((length(rmv) - sum(rmv)) >= this_minimum_events) {
    res <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor(
      PSI,
      y,
      use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
      method = cor_method
    ))
  }
  as.numeric(res)
}

partial_cor <- function(
  y_name,
  y,
  rest_dt,
  cor_method,
  this_minimum_events = minimum_events
) {
  this_rest_dt <- copy(rest_dt)
  if (y_name %in% names(this_rest_dt)) {
    this_rest_dt <- this_rest_dt[, !..y_name]
  }
  this_rest_dt[, test_column := y]

  # Conditioners present in this group, MINUS any that are entirely NA within it
  # (e.g. 5ssup/3ssdown — MaxEntScan AND Pangolin — for RI, which has no
  # upstream/downstream exon). Without this, na.omit() below would drop EVERY row
  # of the group -> NA partial correlation for that whole event type. Restrict to
  # the usable columns first, so only genuinely-incomplete rows are removed.
  this_non_epigenetic_features <- intersect(
    non_epigenetic_features,
    names(this_rest_dt)
  )
  this_non_epigenetic_features <- this_non_epigenetic_features[
    vapply(
      this_non_epigenetic_features,
      function(col) !all(is.na(this_rest_dt[[col]])),
      logical(1)
    )
  ]
  keep_cols <- c("PSI", "test_column", this_non_epigenetic_features)
  this_rest_dt <- na.omit(this_rest_dt[, ..keep_cols])
  corr <- NA_real_

  if (
    this_rest_dt[, .N] >= this_minimum_events &&
      stats::sd(this_rest_dt[, test_column]) != 0 &&
      stats::sd(this_rest_dt[, PSI]) != 0
  ) {
    if (length(this_non_epigenetic_features) > 0L) {
      rhs <- paste0("`", this_non_epigenetic_features, "`", collapse = " + ")
      psi_res <- resid(stats::lm(
        stats::as.formula(paste("PSI ~", rhs)),
        data = this_rest_dt
      ))
      test_res <- resid(stats::lm(
        stats::as.formula(paste("test_column ~", rhs)),
        data = this_rest_dt
      ))
      cor_result <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor.test(
        test_res,
        psi_res,
        method = cor_method
      ))
    } else {
      cor_result <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor.test(
        this_rest_dt$test_column,
        this_rest_dt$PSI,
        method = cor_method
      ))
    }
    corr <- unname(cor_result$estimate)
  }

  as.numeric(corr)
}

prepare_with_all_variability <- function(input_dt) {
  prepared_dt <- copy(input_dt)
  prepared_dt[
    metadata,
    on = c(IHEC = "epirr_id_without_version"),
    annotation := harmonized_sample_ontology_term_high_order_fig1
  ]
  rbind(
    prepared_dt,
    copy(prepared_dt)[, Variability := "All"]
  )
}

append_protocol_levels <- function(input_cor_dt) {
  output_dt <- copy(input_cor_dt)
  output_dt[file_metadata, on = .(uuid), protocol := experiment_type]
  output_dt <- rbind(output_dt, copy(output_dt)[, protocol := "All"])
  output_dt[, protocol := factor(protocol)]
  output_dt
}

compute_all_cor <- function(input_dt, apply_preprocessing = FALSE) {
  # add verbosity
  message(sprintf(
    "Computing correlations (apply_preprocessing = %s) for %d rows",
    apply_preprocessing,
    nrow(input_dt)
  ))
  prepared_dt <- prepare_with_all_variability(input_dt)

  bind_group_results <- function(results, stage_label) {
    is_bindable <- vapply(
      results,
      function(x) {
        data.table::is.data.table(x) || is.data.frame(x) || is.list(x)
      },
      logical(1)
    )
    if (!all(is_bindable)) {
      first_bad <- which(!is_bindable)[1]
      stop(
        sprintf(
          "%s failed in group index %d. First worker output: %s",
          stage_label,
          first_bad,
          paste(capture.output(str(results[[first_bad]])), collapse = " ")
        )
      )
    }
    data.table::rbindlist(results)
  }

  transform_group <- function(group_dt) {
    if (!apply_preprocessing) {
      return(group_dt)
    }

    preprocess_data_table_features(
      dt = group_dt,
      feature_cols = sdcols,
      histone_marks = histone_marks,
      mode = "correlation",
      max_na_frac = 1,
      drop_sparse = FALSE
    )$dt
  }

  # add verbosity
  message(sprintf(
    "Compute full correlations"
  ))
  cor_dt <- rbindlist(
    lapply(setNames(cor_methods, cor_methods), function(cor_method) {
      groups_list <- split(prepared_dt, by = aggregation_columns)

      group_results <- pbmclapply(
        groups_list,
        function(group_dt) {
          # single-thread each fork (see full-correlation worker above): the
          # lm()/cor.test() here hit BLAS, so without this each of the 10 forks
          # spawns ncores BLAS threads -> ncores×10 oversubscription.
          data.table::setDTthreads(1L)
          try(RhpcBLASctl::blas_set_num_threads(1L), silent = TRUE)
          proc_group_dt <- transform_group(group_dt)
          proc_group_dt[,
            lapply(.SD, full_cor, PSI, cor_method),
            by = aggregation_columns,
            .SDcols = sdcols
          ]
        },
        mc.cores = min(getOption("EpiATLAS_AS_CORES", 4), 4)
      )
      bind_group_results(
        group_results,
        sprintf("full correlation (%s)", cor_method)
      )
    }),
    idcol = "Correlation Coefficient"
  )
  cor_dt[, `Correlation Coefficient` := as.factor(`Correlation Coefficient`)]
  cor_dt[, `Partial Correlation` := FALSE]

  # add verbosity
  message(sprintf(
    "Compute partial correlations"
  ))
  pcor_dt <- rbindlist(
    lapply(setNames(cor_methods, cor_methods), function(cor_method) {
      groups_list <- split(prepared_dt, by = aggregation_columns)

      group_results <- pbmclapply(
        groups_list,
        function(group_dt) {
          # single-thread each fork (see full-correlation worker above): the
          # lm()/cor.test() here hit BLAS, so without this each of the 10 forks
          # spawns ncores BLAS threads -> ncores×10 oversubscription.
          data.table::setDTthreads(1L)
          try(RhpcBLASctl::blas_set_num_threads(1L), silent = TRUE)
          proc_group_dt <- transform_group(group_dt)
          rest_cols <- intersect(
            c("PSI", non_epigenetic_features),
            names(proc_group_dt)
          )
          rest_dt <- proc_group_dt[, ..rest_cols]
          proc_group_dt[,
            mapply(
              y_name = sdcols,
              y = .SD,
              FUN = partial_cor,
              MoreArgs = list(
                rest_dt = rest_dt,
                cor_method = cor_method
              ),
              SIMPLIFY = FALSE
            ),
            by = aggregation_columns,
            .SDcols = sdcols
          ]
        },
        mc.cores = min(getOption("EpiATLAS_AS_CORES", 4), 4)
      )
      bind_group_results(
        group_results,
        sprintf("partial correlation (%s)", cor_method)
      )
    }),
    idcol = "Correlation Coefficient"
  )
  pcor_dt[, `Correlation Coefficient` := as.factor(`Correlation Coefficient`)]
  pcor_dt[, `Partial Correlation` := TRUE]

  all_cor_dt <- rbind(cor_dt, pcor_dt)
  all_cor_dt[,
    Variability := factor(Variability, levels = c("Low", "All", "High"))
  ]
  append_protocol_levels(all_cor_dt)
}

if (file.exists(corr_file_raw)) {
  all_cor_raw <- fread(corr_file_raw, stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
} else {
  all_cor_raw <- compute_all_cor(aggregated_dt, apply_preprocessing = FALSE)
  fwrite(all_cor_raw, corr_file_raw)
}

if (file.exists(corr_file_preproc)) {
  all_cor_preproc <- fread(corr_file_preproc, stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
} else {
  all_cor_preproc <- compute_all_cor(aggregated_dt, apply_preprocessing = TRUE)
  fwrite(all_cor_preproc, corr_file_preproc)
}
# RESOLVED 2026-07-12: this used to be a real open question -- answered by `05`'s
# NA-Variability fix (events with < 2 non-NA PSI samples get Variability unset,
# per 02-3's read-coverage/VST masking). `05` now drops those rows before writing
# aggregated_dt_filtered_{tf}.csv.gz (see 05-create-aggregated-dt.Rmd.md's
# NA-Variability note), so `aggregated_dt` here should never contain one --
# confirmed on the current on-disk output (0 NA/blank Variability values). The
# stopifnot below is accordingly a defense-in-depth check against a regression
# upstream, not an open investigation.
all_cor_raw[, Preprocessing := "Raw"]
all_cor_preproc[, Preprocessing := "Preprocessed"]
all_cor <- rbind(all_cor_raw, all_cor_preproc, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
all_cor[,
  Preprocessing := factor(Preprocessing, levels = c("Raw", "Preprocessed"))
]
all_cor[, stopifnot(
  "Some entries in the correlation data have NA for Variability. These will be removed. This should not happen" = all(
    !is.na(Variability)
  )
)]
```

```{r, nicer-names}
# this chunk just changes some names in the dt so the plots look nicer
melt_cor_dt <- melt(
  all_cor,
  id.vars = c(
    "Event Type",
    "transcript_filter",
    "uuid",
    "Variability",
    "Partial Correlation",
    "Correlation Coefficient",
    "protocol",
    "Preprocessing"
  ),
  variable.name = "feature",
  value.name = "Correlation w/ PSI"
)
# §4.12b: normalise the vst feature name back to the generic label so the
# existing relabel chain below ("gene expression" -> "Gene\nExpression") works.
melt_cor_dt[, feature := sub("gene_expression_vst", "gene_expression", feature)]
melt_cor_dt[, `Event Type` := factor(`Event Type`, levels = c("SE", "RI"))]
melt_cor_dt[
  `Event Type` == "SE",
  feature := gsub("other_region", "Intron", feature, fixed = TRUE)
]
melt_cor_dt[
  `Event Type` == "RI",
  feature := gsub("other_region", "Exon", feature, fixed = TRUE)
]
melt_cor_dt[
  `Event Type` == "SE",
  feature := gsub("event_name", "SE", feature, fixed = TRUE)
]
melt_cor_dt[
  `Event Type` == "RI",
  feature := gsub("event_name", "RI", feature, fixed = TRUE)
]
melt_cor_dt[, feature := sub(";", "\n", feature, fixed = TRUE)]
melt_cor_dt[, feature := sub(",", "\n", feature, fixed = TRUE)]
melt_cor_dt[, feature := gsub("_", " ", feature, fixed = TRUE)]
melt_cor_dt[, feature := sub("distance ", "Distance\n", feature, fixed = TRUE)]
melt_cor_dt[,
  feature := sub("upstream Intron", "Intron\nUpstream", feature, fixed = TRUE)
]
melt_cor_dt[,
  feature := sub("upstream Exon", "Exon\nUpstream", feature, fixed = TRUE)
]
melt_cor_dt[,
  feature := sub(
    "downstream Intron",
    "Intron\nDownstream",
    feature,
    fixed = TRUE
  )
]
melt_cor_dt[,
  feature := sub("downstream Exon", "Exon\nDownstream", feature, fixed = TRUE)
]
melt_cor_dt[,
  feature := sub("gene expression", "Gene\nExpression", feature, fixed = TRUE)
]
melt_cor_dt[, feature := sub("width", "Width", feature, fixed = TRUE)]
aggregate_median_by <- c(
  "feature",
  "Event Type",
  "transcript_filter",
  "Variability",
  "Partial Correlation",
  "Correlation Coefficient",
  "protocol",
  "Preprocessing"
)
melt_cor_dt[,
  median_cor := median(`Correlation w/ PSI`, na.rm = TRUE),
  by = aggregate_median_by
]
melt_cor_dt[,
  mean_cor := mean(`Correlation w/ PSI`, na.rm = TRUE),
  by = aggregate_median_by
]
melt_cor_dt[,
  sd_cor := sd(`Correlation w/ PSI`, na.rm = TRUE),
  by = aggregate_median_by
]
melt_cor_dt[, relevant := any(abs(median_cor) > .1), by = aggregate_median_by]
melt_cor_dt[, Variability := sub(" Variability", "", Variability, fixed = TRUE)]
melt_cor_dt[,
  Variability := factor(Variability, levels = c("Low", "All", "High"))
]
melt_cor_dt[, protocol := factor(protocol)]
melt_cor_dt[,
  Preprocessing := factor(Preprocessing, levels = c("Raw", "Preprocessed"))
]
```

```{r, top10-overall, fig.width=21, fig.height=8}
library(ggh4x)
library(tidytext)
top_n <- 25 # melt_cor_dt[, uniqueN(feature)]
# get the top n correlations with PSI from the feature vector
tmp_cor_dt <- melt_cor_dt[
  Variability == main_variability &
    `Correlation Coefficient` == main_cor &
    `Partial Correlation` == main_partial &
    protocol == main_protocol &
    Preprocessing == main_preprocessing
]
tmp_cor_dt[
  order(-abs(median_cor)),
  .(feature = unique(feature)[1:top_n]),
  by = .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)
]
# annotate epigenetic vs intrinsic features
tmp_cor_dt[,
  "Feature Type" := ifelse(
    Reduce(
      `|`,
      lapply(c(histone_marks, "DNAm"), function(x) startsWith(feature, x))
    ),
    "Epigenetic",
    "Intrinsic"
  )
]
tmp_cor_dt[
  feature %in% c("max promoter", "summed enhancer"),
  `Feature Type` := "Epigenetic"
]
plot_dt <- merge(
  tmp_cor_dt,
  tmp_cor_dt[
    order(-abs(median_cor)),
    .(feature = unique(feature)[1:top_n]),
    by = .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)
  ]
)
# Create a vector of colors for ggplot, defaulting to dark grey
plot_colors <- setNames(
  rep("dark grey", plot_dt[, uniqueN(feature)]),
  plot_dt[, unique(feature)]
)
for (name in names(mark_hex_colors)) {
  inds <- startsWith(names(plot_colors), name)
  plot_colors[inds] <- mark_hex_colors[name]
}
# plot
ggplot(
  plot_dt,
  aes(
    y = `Correlation w/ PSI`,
    x = tidytext::reorder_within(
      feature,
      -median_cor,
      list(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)
    ),
    color = feature
  )
) + # `Feature Type`)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "light grey", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    x = NULL, #' Aggregated Signal or Statistic',
    title = NULL # , paste('Top', top_n, 'Globally Correlated Features')
  ) +
  tidytext::scale_x_reordered() +
  ggh4x::facet_nested_wrap(
    . ~ `Event Type` + factor(transcript_filter, levels = transcript_filters),
    nrow = 2,
    scales = "free_x"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = plot_colors) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white")
  )
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("top", top_n, "intrinsic_overall.png")),
  width = 21,
  height = 6
)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("top", top_n, "intrinsic_overall.svg")),
  width = 21,
  height = 6
)
```

```{r, comparison-plots, fig.width=21, fig.height=8}
# make plots comparing different measures and variability
for (color_by in c(
  "Correlation Coefficient",
  "Partial Correlation",
  "Variability",
  "protocol",
  "Preprocessing"
)) {
  # aggregate the medians by the relevant columns
  find_relevant_by <- aggregate_median_by[aggregate_median_by != color_by]
  # remove column from earlier iteration
  melt_cor_dt[, plot_relevant := NULL]
  # set which columns are relevant
  melt_cor_dt[, plot_relevant := any(relevant), by = mget(find_relevant_by)]
  # get the subset of the table that is relevant depending on what to compare
  not_color_by <- TRUE
  if (color_by == "Partial Correlation") {
    not_color_by <- melt_cor_dt[,
      `Correlation Coefficient` == main_cor &
        Variability == main_variability &
        protocol == main_protocol &
        Preprocessing == main_preprocessing
    ]
  } else if (color_by == "Correlation Coefficient") {
    not_color_by <- melt_cor_dt[,
      `Partial Correlation` == main_partial &
        Variability == main_variability &
        protocol == main_protocol &
        Preprocessing == main_preprocessing
    ]
  } else if (color_by == "Variability") {
    not_color_by <- melt_cor_dt[,
      `Partial Correlation` == main_partial &
        `Correlation Coefficient` == main_cor &
        protocol == main_protocol &
        Preprocessing == main_preprocessing
    ]
  } else if (color_by == "protocol") {
    not_color_by <- melt_cor_dt[,
      `Partial Correlation` == main_partial &
        `Correlation Coefficient` == main_cor &
        Variability == main_variability &
        Preprocessing == main_preprocessing
    ]
  } else if (color_by == "Preprocessing") {
    not_color_by <- melt_cor_dt[,
      `Partial Correlation` == main_partial &
        `Correlation Coefficient` == main_cor &
        Variability == main_variability &
        protocol == main_protocol
    ]
  }
  # get the number of levels we need to color_by
  color_levels <- melt_cor_dt[not_color_by, uniqueN(get(color_by))]
  tmp_cor_dt <- melt_cor_dt[
    not_color_by & !is.na(`Correlation w/ PSI`),
    if (uniqueN(get(color_by)) == color_levels) .SD,
    by = .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter, feature)
  ]
  if (color_by == "Variability") {
    # for variablity make another plot sorted by the greatest differences
    median_dt <- dcast(
      tmp_cor_dt[,
        .(median_cor = unique(median_cor)),
        by = .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter, feature, Variability)
      ],
      `Event Type` + transcript_filter + feature ~ Variability,
      value.var = "median_cor"
    )
    median_dt[, diff_col := abs(`Low` - `High`)]
    sorted_idx <- median_dt[, order(-diff_col)]
    p <- ggplot(
      merge(
        tmp_cor_dt,
        median_dt[
          sorted_idx,
          .(
            feature = feature[1:top_n],
            diff_col = diff_col[1:top_n],
            all_median = All[1:top_n]
          ),
          by = .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)
        ]
      ),
      aes(
        y = `Correlation w/ PSI`,
        x = tidytext::reorder_within(
          feature,
          -diff_col,
          list(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)
        ),
        fill = get(color_by)
      )
    ) +
      theme_bw() +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "darkgrey", linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_boxplot() +
      labs(x = "Aggregated Signal or Statistic") +
      tidytext::scale_x_reordered() +
      ggh4x::facet_nested_wrap(
        . ~ `Event Type` +
          factor(transcript_filter, levels = transcript_filters),
        scales = "free",
        nrow = 2
      ) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = variability_colors[1:color_levels],
        name = color_by
      )
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(
        plot_dir,
        paste0("max diff ", color_by, "_intrinsic.pdf")
      ),
      p,
      width = 21,
      height = 7
    )
    print(p)
  }
  # always make one plot sorted by the median
  p <- ggplot(
    merge(
      tmp_cor_dt,
      tmp_cor_dt[
        order(-abs(median_cor)),
        .(feature = unique(feature)[1:top_n]),
        by = .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)
      ]
    ),
    aes(
      y = `Correlation w/ PSI`,
      x = tidytext::reorder_within(
        feature,
        -median_cor,
        list(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)
      ),
      color = get(color_by)
    )
  ) +
    theme_bw() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "darkgrey", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_boxplot() +
    labs(x = "Aggregated Signal or Statistic") +
    tidytext::scale_x_reordered() +
    ggh4x::facet_nested_wrap(
      . ~ `Event Type` + factor(transcript_filter, levels = transcript_filters),
      scales = "free",
      nrow = 2
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white")
    )
  if (color_by == "Preprocessing") {
    p <- p + scale_color_manual(values = preprocessing_colors, name = color_by)
  } else {
    p <- p + scale_color_manual(values = variability_colors, name = color_by)
  }
  if (color_levels == 2) {
    if (color_by == "Preprocessing") {
      p <- p +
        scale_color_manual(values = preprocessing_colors, name = color_by)
    } else {
      p <- p +
        scale_color_manual(
          values = unname(variability_colors[c(1, 3)]),
          name = color_by
        )
    }
  } else if (color_by == "protocol") {
    p <- p +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = setNames(
          variability_colors,
          c("total-RNA-Seq", "All", "mRNA-Seq")
        ),
        name = color_by
      )
  }
  if (color_by == "Variability") {
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(
        plot_dir,
        paste0("top", top_n, color_by, "_intrinsic.pdf")
      ),
      p,
      width = 21,
      height = 4.5
    )
  } else if (color_by == "Preprocessing") {
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(
        plot_dir,
        paste0("top", top_n, "_preprocessing_intrinsic.pdf")
      ),
      p,
      width = 21,
      height = 4.5
    )
  }
  print(p)
}
```

```{r, top10-preprocessing-comparison, fig.width=21, fig.height=8}
# explicit preprocessing vs no-preprocessing comparison on top features
preproc_cmp_dt <- melt_cor_dt[
  Variability == main_variability &
    `Correlation Coefficient` == main_cor &
    `Partial Correlation` == main_partial &
    protocol == main_protocol
]

preproc_rank_dt <- preproc_cmp_dt[,
  .(median_cor = unique(median_cor)),
  by = .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter, feature, Preprocessing)
]

preproc_diff_dt <- dcast(
  preproc_rank_dt,
  `Event Type` + transcript_filter + feature ~ Preprocessing,
  value.var = "median_cor"
)
preproc_diff_dt[, diff_preproc := abs(Preprocessed - Raw)]

preproc_top_dt <- merge(
  preproc_cmp_dt,
  preproc_diff_dt[
    order(-diff_preproc),
    .(feature = feature[1:top_n]),
    by = .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)
  ]
)

p_preproc <- ggplot(
  preproc_top_dt,
  aes(
    y = `Correlation w/ PSI`,
    x = tidytext::reorder_within(
      feature,
      -median_cor,
      list(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)
    ),
    color = Preprocessing
  )
) +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "darkgrey", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Aggregated Signal or Statistic") +
  tidytext::scale_x_reordered() +
  ggh4x::facet_nested_wrap(
    . ~ `Event Type` + factor(transcript_filter, levels = transcript_filters),
    scales = "free",
    nrow = 2
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = preprocessing_colors)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    plot_dir,
    paste0("top", top_n, "_preprocessing_explicit_intrinsic.pdf")
  ),
  p_preproc,
  width = 21,
  height = 4.5
)
print(p_preproc)
```

```{r, cor-heatmap, fig.width=21, fig.height=8}
# make heatmap with the correlation per feature
heatmap_dt <- unique(melt_cor_dt[
  `Partial Correlation` == main_partial &
    `Correlation Coefficient` == main_cor &
    Variability == main_variability &
    protocol == main_protocol &
    Preprocessing == main_preprocessing &
    grepl(paste(c(histone_marks, "DNAm"), collapse = "|"), x = feature),
  .(
    `Event Type`,
    transcript_filter,
    feature,
    protocol,
    median_cor,
    mean_cor,
    sd_cor
  )
])
heatmap_dt[,
  mark := tstrsplit(x = feature, split = "\n", fixed = TRUE, keep = 1)
]
heatmap_dt[,
  mark := factor(
    mark,
    levels = rev(c(
      "H3K9me3",
      "H3K27me3",
      "H3K4me3",
      "H3K4me1",
      "H3K27ac",
      "H3K36me3",
      "DNAm"
    ))
  )
]
heatmap_dt[, region := sub(pattern = ".*?\n", replacement = "", x = feature)]
heatmap_dt[,
  region := factor(region, levels = c("5up", "5down", "3up", "3down"))
] # c("Intron\nUpstream", "SE", "Intron\nDownstream", "Exon\nUpstream", "RI", "Exon\nDownstream")),]
ggplot(
  heatmap_dt,
  aes(
    x = region,
    y = mark,
    fill = median_cor
  )
) +
  geom_tile() +
  ggh4x::facet_grid2(
    factor(transcript_filter, levels = transcript_filters) ~ `Event Type` +
      protocol,
    scales = "free"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = scales::muted("blue"),
    mid = "white",
    high = scales::muted("red")
  ) +
  # add text into the tile with the value of the mean and sd_cor in parantheses
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = paste0(
        round(median_cor, 2),
        "\n(",
        round(mean_cor, 2),
        "\u00B1",
        round(sd_cor, 2),
        ")"
      )
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(y = "Mark", x = "Region", fill = "Partial Correlation")
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(plot_dir, "epigenetic_cor_intrinsic.pdf"),
  width = 21,
  height = 8
)
```
